name: Chia Seed Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients and let sit overnight in the fridge. Top with fruit before serving.

name: Protein Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine all ingredients and refrigerate overnight. Stir and top with fruit before eating.

name: Protein Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line muffin pan with liners. In a bowl, mix brown sugar, egg, and melted butter. Add applesauce, protein milk, cinnamon, and salt. Stir in oats and baking powder. Pour into muffin liners using a ¼ cup measure. Top with chocolate chips, flax seed, or hemp hearts. Bake for 30 minutes.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, peanut butter, chia seeds, protein milk, and flax seed. Add chopped fruit. Refrigerate overnight before serving.

name: Green Smoothie
instructions: Blend all ingredients together until smooth. Adjust thickness by adding more water if needed. Serve chilled.

name: Chicken Enchilada Soup
instructions: Combine shredded rotisserie chicken, corn, tomatoes, black beans, and soup mix in a pot. Simmer until heated through. Top with cheese before serving.

name: Chili
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in a pot until browned. Add chili mix and tomatoes/beans. Simmer until thickened. Top with 3-cheese mix before serving.

name: Tortellini Soup
instructions: Saute carrots, celery, and onion. Add Italian sausage and cook through. Stir in chicken broth, flour or ranch mix, and tortellini. Simmer until pasta is tender. Add cream and serve.

name: Crack Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: Cream of Chicken or Onion Soup
instructions: Combine all ingredients except cheese in a large pot and bring to a boil. Simmer until vegetables and pasta are tender. Stir in cheddar cheese and serve.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chopped vegetables with soup mix and shredded rotisserie chicken until tender. Serve hot.

name: Loaded Potato Soup
instructions: Fry bacon, then saute celery, onion, and garlic in bacon fat. Add flour, vegetable stock, and bullion. Add cubed potatoes and simmer until tender. Stir in heavy cream and top with cheese and crumbled bacon.

name: Lasagna Soup
instructions: Saute onion and garlic, then brown Italian sausage. Add tomato paste, marinara, broth, and heavy cream. Add noodles and cook until tender. Serve topped with mixed cheeses and herbs.

name: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
instructions: Saute carrots, celery, and onion in butter. Add garlic and flour, then stir in broth. Bring to a boil, add orzo, and cook until tender. Add shredded chicken and lemon juice/zest before serving.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Add sliced peppers, onions, and chicken to crockpot. Sprinkle fajita seasoning over and cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours. Serve in tortillas with cheese and rice.

name: Roast
ingredients: Pot Roast Seasoning or Onion Mix
instructions: Place roast in crockpot and surround with chopped potatoes, onions, and carrots. Add seasoning and beef stock. Cook on low for 8-10 hours or high for 4-5 hours.

name: Carnitas
instructions: Season and sear pork. Add to crockpot with broth, juices, chilis, onion, and seasonings. Cook on low for 7-8 hours. Shred and serve in tortillas.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Add chicken, onion, cream of chicken soup, and vegetables to crockpot. Cook on low 4-6 hours. Stir in half and half. Serve with biscuits.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
ingredients: Cream of Celery or Onion Soup
instructions: Add chicken, vegetables, soups, broth, and seasoning to crockpot. Cook on high for 4 hours. Shred chicken and add biscuits on top before serving.

name: Pulled Pork
instructions: Add pork and barbecue sauce to crockpot. Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4-5. Shred and serve on buns.

name: Crockpot Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Add chicken, cream, broth, cream cheese, and butter to crockpot. Cook on high for 2 hours. Shred chicken and add pasta and parmesan. Cook 30 minutes more.

name: Crockpot Creamy Lemon Chicken
instructions: Sear chicken in butter, then add to crockpot with lemon juice, zest, garlic, and sliced butter. Deglaze pan with stock and add to crockpot. Cook on low for 4 hours. Mix half and half, cornstarch, and chicken base. Add and cook 1 hour more.

name: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot. Mix garlic, ginger, honey, sugar, soy sauce, oil, and vinegar. Pour over chicken. Cook low 6-7 hours or high 3-4. Thicken sauce with cornstarch slurry if needed.

name: Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef and chopped onion in a skillet. Drain excess grease. Spoon into tortillas and top with cheese. Serve hot.

name: Meatballs and Spaghetti
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions. Heat meatballs and sauce in a pot until warmed through. Combine and top with cheese before serving.

name: Cheeseburger Sliders with Mac n Cheese
instructions: Form ground beef into small patties and cook with sliced onion. Toast buns and assemble with cheese. Serve with mac n cheese if desired.

name: Ravioli
instructions: Boil ravioli until tender. Drain and mix with heated spaghetti sauce. Top with cheese and serve.

name: Gigi Hadid Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta and reserve 1 cup pasta water. In a pan, sauté shallots and garlic in olive oil. Add tomato paste and cook 2-3 minutes. Add heavy cream and red pepper flakes, then stir in pasta, reserved water, butter, and parmesan. Season and serve.

name: Creamy Sausage Bowtie Pasta
instructions: Brown sausage and garlic. Cook pasta separately. Add flour to sausage, then stir in cream and broth. Add spinach and cheese. Stir in drained pasta and serve.

name: French Onion Pasta
instructions: Caramelize onions in butter, then deglaze with white wine. Add pasta, beef stock, Worcestershire, and thyme. Simmer until pasta is cooked. Stir in gruyere and half and half.

name: French Onion Chicken
instructions: Sear chicken in butter, then set aside. Saute onions, then add soup mix and canned soup. Return chicken and simmer. Top with cheese and serve with potatoes.

name: Soupy Chicken
instructions: Sear seasoned chicken and onions in butter and oil. Add soup and milk. Simmer until chicken is cooked through. Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

name: Breaded Chicken
instructions: Dredge chicken in flour, then egg, then breadcrumb and cheese mix. Shallow fry in olive oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked.

name: Barbecue Chicken Bake
instructions: Sear seasoned chicken in butter. Transfer to greased baking dish. Top with BBQ sauce and cheese. Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes. Top with cooked bacon and serve.

name: Sausage and Peppers
instructions: Sear sausage, then set aside. Saute onion and garlic, then add peppers and cook until tender. Return sausage and heat through. Serve with pasta if desired.

name: Parmesan-Crusted Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Melt butter and mix with olive oil, garlic, parsley, parmesan, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Slice potatoes in half and toss in the mixture. Dip the flat side of each potato in extra parmesan and lay crust side down on a baking sheet. Roast for 30–40 minutes until golden.

name: Parmesan-Garlic Butter Pizza Rolls
instructions: Fry pizza rolls until crisp. Toss in garlic butter and top with parmesan. Serve with marinara sauce for dipping.

name: Mac n Cheese
instructions: Cook and drain noodles. Shred and divide cheeses. Melt butter and add flour to make a roux. Stir in evaporated milk and heavy cream until thickened. Season and add half of cheese. Combine with noodles and layer remaining cheese. Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cube potatoes. Boil in salted water until fork-tender. Drain and return to pot. Mash with butter, cream, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste.

name: Roasted Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Trim tops of garlic heads to expose cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Wrap in foil and roast for 30–40 minutes until soft and golden.

name: No Bake Cookies
instructions: In a saucepan, melt sugar, milk, butter, and cocoa powder. Bring to a boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla, oats, and peanut butter. Scoop onto parchment-lined baking sheet and refrigerate until firm.

name: Protein Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until well combined. Chill for 1–2 hours. Roll into balls and refrigerate.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream sugars and butter. Add egg and vanilla. In another bowl, combine salt, flour, and baking soda. Mix dry into wet. Fold in chocolate chips. Chill dough 2 hours. Bake at 250°F for 8–13 minutes.

name: Chocolate Covered Raspberries
instructions: Mash raspberries and place on parchment paper. Add a dollop of melted peanut butter. Freeze. Melt chocolate with coconut oil, dip each raspberry dollop, and freeze until solid.

name: S'mores Cookie Bars
instructions: Recipe not fully provided. Please add ingredients and instructions manually.

name: Ricotta Meatballs
instructions: Mix ricotta, garlic, and seasonings. Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. In a bowl, combine egg, half and half, breadcrumbs, cheese, ricotta mix, sautéed onion. Add seasoned meat and form into meatballs. Refrigerate 15 min. Brown in oil, then add to sauce and cook covered 30 min. Add remaining ricotta on top. Serve with pasta.

name: Rigatoni P
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Roast mushrooms, onion, and garlic with balsamic vinegar. Sear chicken in butter and oil. Deglaze with white and marsala wine. Add chicken broth and cornstarch slurry, cook until thick. Mix in cream, cheese, parsley, and roasted vegetables. Combine with cooked pasta and bake until golden.

name: Stir Fry
instructions: Make sauce by mixing soy sauce, stock, oil, vinegar, garlic, ginger, sugar, cornstarch, and red pepper. Stir fry meat and set aside. Sauté onion, snap peas, and peppers. Add meat back and pour sauce over. Simmer until thickened. Serve with rice or noodles.

name: Asian-Style Beef Burgers
instructions: Rehydrate mushrooms. Sauté carrots and broccoli in sesame oil. Add water and vinegar, cook until soft. Make patties from beef, scallions, mushrooms, garlic, hoisin. Sear patties. Toast buns. Assemble with bok choy and cooked veggies. Garnish with scallion tops.

name: Beef and Broccoli
instructions: Brown beef with ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper. Add coleslaw mix and sauce. Cook rice ramen separately. Combine beef mix with noodles and broccoli. Serve hot.
